channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Reggie Jackson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Reggie Jackson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Michael Malone on Reggie Jackson, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray
item.description:
“We probably had quite a few minutes of that tonight. … Reggie, I think, has done a really good job in place of Jamal. But just like if Nikola goes down, we don’t have another Nikola Jokic. We don’t have another Jamal Murray.”

Michael Malone on Reggie Jackson, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, Nov 25, 2023. Source: Hoops Rumors.

item.title: Michael Malone on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
“The Reggie Jackson I’ve seen all summer long I think is more than ready to come in here and help this team coming off of our bench,”

Michael Malone on Reggie Jackson, Oct 3, 2023. Source: DNVR.

item.title: LeBron James on Sam Presti, Jeff Green, Serge Ibaka, Reggie Jackson, Josh Giddey
item.description:
“Josh Giddey is great. Sam Presti, I don’t understand this guy’s eye for talent. He drafted KD, Russ [Westbrook], Jeff Green, Serge Ibaka, Reggie Jackson, Josh Giddey and the list goes on and on and on. This guy is pretty damn good.”

LeBron James on Sam Presti, Jeff Green, Serge Ibaka, Reggie Jackson, Josh Giddey, Feb 20, 2022. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
Law Murray:Frank on Reggie Jackson:

“We talked about kind of like, Paul's narrative changing. But Reggie, it just goes to show that, you know, sometimes, we're quick to make judgments, and we don't necessarily understand that...”

Lawrence Frank on Reggie Jackson, Sep 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
“Reggie elevates our team with his energy, his confidence, and his ability to be at his best in the biggest moments,”

Lawrence Frank on Reggie Jackson, Aug 11, 2021. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
“We want them back as Clippers. We respect that they have a choice to make. With Kawhi, we hope to have a very long-term relationship with him... We'd like to bring Reggie, Nico back. We hope Serge opts in. We have other FA as well.”

Lawrence Frank on Reggie Jackson, Jul 30, 2021. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Ivica Zubac on Nicolas Batum, Reggie Jackson
item.description:
Law Murray:Ivica Zubac on Reggie Jackson, Nicolas Batum:

“They're great guys, I don't think anyone expected them to do what they did this year.”

Ivica Zubac on Nicolas Batum, Reggie Jackson, Jul 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
Andrew Greif:Ty Lue on Reggie:

“He loves these moments. He was talking trash all day. ... keeping our guys' spirits up.”

Tyronn Lue on Reggie Jackson, Jun 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @AndrewGreif.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Ty Lue:

“I gotta do a better job in the first half getting those guys (PG and Reggie) the right amount of rest.”

Tyronn Lue on Reggie Jackson, Jun 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Nicolas Batum on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Nicolas Batum on his comfort playing at the 5:

“It's new for me... so I'm learning, a learning process for me during the playoff. I just do my best to make life easier for my two superstars. And Reggie and Luke.”

Nicolas Batum on Reggie Jackson, Jun 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Reggie Jackson, Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Law Murray:Tyronn Lue on former Hornet Nicolas Batum:

“Without Reggie (Jackson) and Nico this year, we could have been in the Play-In game”

Tyronn Lue on Reggie Jackson, Nicolas Batum, May 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Luke Kennard on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Luke Kennard in shootaround, asked about Reggie Jackson:

“Reggie, it always seems like he's in a good mood. He's always loud, talking to everybody. Always just ... being Reggie. That's how I can describe it.”

Luke Kennard on Reggie Jackson, Apr 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
Ty Lue on asking Reggie to take a backseat while the Clips tried a different rotation:

“It was a hard conversation for me because I thought he'd been playing well.”

Tyronn Lue on Reggie Jackson, Jan 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Montrezl Harrell on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
Montrezl Harrell on Reggie Jackson:

“He doesn't try to force anything, he knows his role, he knows who he is, and he's fine with that.”

Montrezl Harrell on Reggie Jackson, Mar 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @Farbod_E.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
“Reggie is a proven playmaker and scorer, and we are looking forward to adding his experience and creativity to our team,”

Lawrence Frank on Reggie Jackson, Feb 20, 2020. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Reggie Jackson, Andre Drummond
item.description:
“I think we’re gonna get a great season out of Reggie Jackson, a great year out of Andre Drummond,”

Dwane Casey on Reggie Jackson, Andre Drummond, Sep 2, 2019. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: PistonsDwane Casey on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Reggie Jackson's recovery from an ankle sprain:

“If he’s in uniform, he’s going to play. We’re going to war and he says he’s okay and can go,so we have to be ready to roll from that standpoint.”

PistonsDwane Casey on Reggie Jackson, Mar 15, 2019. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Ed Stefanski on Blake Griffin, Reggie Jackson, Andre Drummond
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Ed Stefanski on potential of trading any of their Big 3 of Griffin, Drummond or Jackson at the deadline:

“You always look at things but you need that other team to work with you.”

Ed Stefanski on Blake Griffin, Reggie Jackson, Andre Drummond, Feb 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Ed Stefanski on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
#Pistons Ed Stefanski:

“Reggie is fully healed. We did an MRI a couple weeks ago. It was perfect. Now, it's just basketball shape...hoping to get him ready to go opening night.”

Ed Stefanski on Reggie Jackson, Sep 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
#Pistons Griffin:

“We missed Reggie Jackson badly. When Ish is starting, it takes away from him leading our second unit, so our team was just a little off.”

Blake Griffin on Reggie Jackson, Jul 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Luke Kennard on Reggie Jackson, Andre Drummond
item.description:
Luke Kennard:

“When you get a player like that … he’s been in the league a long time. And, obviously, we have Andre (Drummond) and Reggie (Jackson) and some really good players. But we get Blake, and just his approach to different things in the game, you see that and try to follow that a little bit. We definitely built a good relationship when he got here — the entire team did. We were a close team. I think it’s going to carry over into this next season. I really do.”

Luke Kennard on Reggie Jackson, Andre Drummond, Jul 5, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Ed Stefanski, Reggie Jackson, Andre Drummond
item.description:
“I had a couple of great meetings, one with the management, with Ed Stefanski, who's a great GM, a great guy, he's a main reason why the job is appealing, along with (Blake Griffin) and also Andre Drummond and Reggie Jackson,”

Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Ed Stefanski, Reggie Jackson, Andre Drummond, Jun 10, 2018. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Tom Gores on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
#Pistons Gores on why they didn't win this year:

“For sure, Reggie. You can see the incredible difference he’s made. At the same time, we have to be prepared ... Reggie has made a difference but we have to get used to players get injured. No excuses -- we have no excuses.”

Tom Gores on Reggie Jackson, Apr 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Tom Gores on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
Interesting from #Pistons Gores on seeing Reggie and Blake play together:

“It’s just a small sample, so we can’t get confused by that. Blake’s been a great addition; he’s a real leader. I don’t think I’ll take this small sample of the last 10-12 games and make it our future.”

Tom Gores on Reggie Jackson, Apr 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Reggie Jackson, Andre Drummond
item.description:
#Pistons Blake Griffin on core of Drummond, Jackson and himself going into next season:

“Having Reggie and Andre and a full group healthy and ready to go, I like our squad – we have a pretty high ceiling and we can make a run in the East.”

Blake Griffin on Reggie Jackson, Andre Drummond, Apr 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
But the sequence represented a small sample of what coach Stan Van Gundy hopes will eventually become the Pistons version of a Big 3.

“If we can get Reggie healthy and keep him healthy, with those three guys, that’s going to be a formidable group to play against for anybody,”

Stan Van Gundy on Reggie Jackson, Mar 21, 2018. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
#Pistons Stan Van Gundy on Reggie Jackson's ankle rehab progress:

“The plan right now is hopefully he’ll be able to run over the All-Star break ... I don’t think he’ll be cutting by then. It’s all a buildup. That’s the hope: (Feb. 15th-21st), he’ll be running.”

Stan Van Gundy on Reggie Jackson, Feb 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Bob Beyer on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons associate coach Bob Beyer on losing Reggie Jackson to ankle injury:

“That’s a big loss for us; we have to go next man up and move on.”

Bob Beyer on Reggie Jackson, Dec 27, 2017. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Avery Bradley on Reggie Jackson
item.description:
Pistons shooting guard Avery Bradley implored for Jackson to be more aggressive following both losses to begin at the three-game trip – Wednesday night at Milwaukee and Friday night at Indiana.

“(Jackson) is a very good scorer, but let your scoring make plays for our team, your aggressiveness,”

Avery Bradley on Reggie Jackson, Nov 20, 2017. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Eric Bledsoe, Reggie Jackson
item.description:
“I left practice yesterday and there’s a rumor out on Reggie and Bledsoe so I had to get home and call Reggie and say we’re not trading you for Bledsoe. I don’t usually address all of them but it’s early in the (season). You can’t address all of them at the trade deadline, but I felt the need to address this.”

Stan Van Gundy on Eric Bledsoe, Reggie Jackson, Nov 4, 2017. Source: Detroit News.
